notes: PrefLib file 00017-00000001.toi (dataset 00017, 'berkley'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 2 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.

label_sources.official_winners: Alameda County Registrar of Voters, "Ranked-Choice Voting Official Final Accumulated Results - Member, City Council, District 7 - Berkeley" (https://www.acgov.org/rov/rcv/results2010-11-02/rcvresults_3981.htm).
label_sources.max_ranks: Alameda County and San Francisco ranked-choice ballots allowed 3 rankings (every ballot in the file has 3 or fewer ranks).
